/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.ids = set(); self.labels = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if 'id' in attrs:
            assert attrs['id'] not in self.ids
            self.ids.add(attrs['id'])
        if 'aria-labelledby' in attrs:
            self.labels.extend(attrs['aria-labelledby'].split())
p = Check()
s = Path('src/pricing.html').read_text()
p.feed(s)
assert all(label in p.ids for label in p.labels)
assert all(price in s for price in ('"'$0'"', '"'$8'"', '"'$20'"'))
print('HTML parsed; plan labels resolve and original prices are preserved.')
PY"
